concerns.text: The plan acknowledges that no open dataset currently provides the required variables (plasma_power_w, exposure_time_s, chemical_concentration_pct, polymer_surface_energy, substrate_roughness_nm, adhesion_strength_mj_m2) and proposes proceeding with a synthetic data generator only if approved (see 'Data Availability & Mitigation' section). This violates FR‑001 which mandates retrieval of real datasets from NIST, Zenodo, or Materials Project, and leaves the core research question unanswerable with real data. A suitable real dataset must be identified or the research question and functional requirements must be revised before proceeding.
